unah_hdx_2015.licence: Public Domain / No restrictions (CC0) - as stated on the HDX dataset page
unah_hdx_2015.notes: Columns used: TOTAL 2015, TASA (2015, per 100,000), TOTAL 2014. area_id = GEOCODIGO MUNICIPIO. Where POBLACION is "-" the source gives TASA 0; kept as published. Population and the "incremento" column are not copied. The file has 297 municipality rows; they add to 4,273 (2015) and 4,949 (2014). The file does not state whether it is complete.

Homicide victims (Observatorio Nacional de la Violencia UNAH)

problems: Two more SEPOL files exist at the same URL pattern: "Cierre anual por municipio 2021.pdf" (titled 2021) and "Cierre anual por municipio 2021(1).pdf" (titled 2022). Their tables are identical number for number (Total general 3,439, while the municipalities add to 3,441), so at least one carries the wrong year; both are left out of data.csv and kept in raw/ (the second saved as sepol_cierre_anual_municipio_2022.pdf). These "incidencia" totals (2023: 3,058) differ from SEPOL's national historical homicide count chart (which shows 3,356 for 2023 if read in order), so they may count incidents or a different cut-off; the source does not say. Name matches by hand: ISLAS DE LA BAHÍA = geoBoundaries "Bay Islands"; COPAN/CABAÑAS = "Cabana"; SAN PEDRO DE COPÁN = "San Pedro"; VILLEDA MORALES = "Ramón Villeda Morales"; SAN MARCOS DE LA SIERRA = "San Marcos de Sierra". NUEVA FRONTERA (Santa Bárbara) has no geoBoundaries polygon. UNAH Tabla 2 names the department capital of El Paraíso as YUSCARÁN and of Gracias a Dios as PUERTO LEMPIRA.
